Name: (CP) No reins for me
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
have you been tired of having to hassle with reins when you're trying to fly your broom or ride your tractor? Does it get tangled in your steering wheel and is an overall 5 pixel eyesore?

Suffer no more! Here's the solution of a little CP mod that switches out the rein arms on the farmers sheet for ones that don't have any! Enjoy!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FzBk4Tg2/title2-1-campatibility.png[/img]
Compatible....well it just changes two pair of arms. If you happen to have another CP mod that changes those two arms....won't work but otherwise it's good, haha!
